This Writ Petition is filed to issue a Writ of Mandamus, or any other order or direction in the nature of Writ, directing the 1st respondent to consider the petitioner's representation dated 25.10.2024 followed by his reminder representation dated 21.07.2025 and to pay monetary benefits i.e., arrears of salary from 12.11.2015 to 10.12.2022.
